text:
deploy-bot: SBOM scan finished for release 2026.02.15-rc4. Action: quarantine artifact.
deploy-bot: Summary: 1 transitive CVE (CVE-2026-0420) found in 'fast-parse' <=1.3.2, severity: MEDIUM, no patch available. Policy: block-publish. Details: https://ci.internal/sbom/2026.02.15-rc4/report

Avery (releases): ugh, saw the bot. can we get a quick triage? is this a blocker for the global cut? :thinking_face:

Priya (security): triage: transitive in a dev-tooling dep used at build time but ends up in runtime delta for a small component of the inference router. exploitability: low but detectable. policy says block if transitive affects runtime. recommending temporary regional quarantine while we assess.

Liam (platform): can we carve out non-production regions and proceed with prod? need to know surface area — which routes use the affected component in prod?

Priya (security): affected service: inference-proxy v3.2.2 image includes the dep via builder. traffic impact ~5% of per-token routing (experimental routes). not core model serving.

Jordan (oncall): +1 to carveout for EU and APAC, keep NA live. we should hold canary in EU until we confirm. no user-facing rollback needed yet.

Avery (releases): proposed action: 1) block global publish of rc4 (deploybot already did). 2) unpublish EU canary (regional quarantine) and promote previous digest in EU only. 3) timebox 2h for security to produce mitigation plan (pin, patch, or compensating control). 4) if not done, full rollback. everyone ok?

Priya (security): fine with timebox. quick mitigation options: - shrinkwrap the build to previous working digest for EU (fast) - attempt a scoped zap/patch with builder (takes longer) - restrict the affected routes via routing policy (low risk). I'll start evidence capture and CVE reproduction steps now.

Nadia (legal): please capture SBOM provenance and sign-off evidence for the carveout. if customers ask, we need an audit trail showing decision and containment scope.

Liam (platform): operational steps I'll run now:
```
# commands to pin EU image to previous digest
rbctl releases promote --from digest:sha256:abcd1234 --to region:eu-west-1 --service inference-proxy
rbctl traffic set --service inference-proxy --region eu-west-1 --routes '^/experimental' --weight 0
```
I'll send logs to the incident channel when done.

Avery (releases): Jordan, can you please gate the release notes update? add a short note: 'Regional quarantine applied in EU due to transitive vuln; investigating.' keep it factual.

Jordan (oncall): noted, will add and mark as post-deploy followup.

Priya (security): evidence collected: SBOM snapshot, dependency tree, exploitability notes. attaching link: https://ci.internal/sbom/2026.02.15-rc4/evidence (internal). Working on recommended patch timeline — will try shrinkwrap first.

deploy-bot: action executed: regional-quarantine enacted for eu-west-1 at 2026-02-15T14:03Z. Previous digest abcd1234 promoted. Publish blocked.

Avery (releases): thanks team. we'll reconvene in the thread in 90 minutes or sooner if new info. If mitigation completes, we'll consider a staggered re-release to NA only with monitoring.

Priya (security): starting remediation, will post ETA in 30m.

Liam (platform): logs: https://ci.internal/ops/logs/promote-1747689999 (pushed to incident).

Nadia (legal): copying audit: I've noted the containment decision and retention link.

Jordan (oncall): leaving a :thumbsup: here once we confirm traffic metrics are stable.

Avery (releases): decision summary (pinned here): quarantine EU canary, block global publish, 2h timebox for mitigation, fallback = rollback. document this in release notes and incident tracker.

Priya (security): update: shrinkwrap patch applied to builder at +47m, CI rebuild green. requesting security review before re-release to EU.

Avery (releases): great — once Priya gives go, Liam can flip EU canary back to rc4-rebuilt, and we'll follow staggered re-release. closing interim thread when done.
